results.title: Filters recompute counts not just filter

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with sources spanning multiple countries
When the country filter is applied to France only
Then source count becomes France-only count and rank is recomputed

results.notes: frandroid.com: 26 articles global -> 17 France-only. Rank changed: automobile-propre.com rose from #3 to #2, largus.fr (French site) appeared in top 3. Total sources: 167 global -> 71 France-only.

results.title: Source type filter recomputes ranks and tab membership

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with Journalism and other source types visible
When the user selects Journalisme from the source type filter
Then only Journalism sources remain, ranks renumbered sequentially from 1, counts recomputed

results.notes: Journalisme filter applied in France+Spain scope: 61 Journalisme sources shown (was 113 total). All visible cards type=Journalisme. Ranks 1-6 sequential, no gaps. Non-Journalism sources (kbb.com Agregateurs) correctly excluded.

results.title: Filter lists only types present in scope

steps.title: Given Actions Center is open in France+Spain scope
When the source type filter dropdown is opened
Then it lists only types present in scope with accurate counts

results.notes: Dropdown showed exactly 7 types: Agregateurs(8)+Entreprise(25)+Gouvernement-ONG(3)+Journalisme(61)+Autre(8)+Sites d avis(6)+Reseaux sociaux-UGC(2)=113 total. No phantom types with 0 count. All counts sum to the exact total sources in scope.

results.title: Date range filter counts articles with answers in range

steps.title: Given a source has 4 failing articles but only 2 within Last 7 days
When the user applies Last 7 days date range filter
Then source shows 2 articles and rank recomputed

results.notes: SKIP: Dataset entirely within the 7-day window. Identical results for 7 derniers jours and Toutes les analyses (same sources, same counts, same total 113). Given condition (source with articles outside 7-day range) not present in current dataset. Date picker requires explicit Appliquer button to confirm selection.

results.title: Multi-scope article counts if one answer in scope

steps.title: Given a failing article has qualifying answers from both France and USA-Spain
When the country filter is set to France
Then the failing article is counted in the France scope

results.notes: frandroid.com: 26 articles global, 17 France-only, 14 USA+Spain-only. 17+14=31>26 confirms 5 articles are counted in BOTH France and USA+Spain scopes (each has at least one qualifying answer in each scope). Multi-scope counting is correct.

results.title: Source with no failing articles in scope disappears

steps.title: Given largus.fr visible at rank 6 in France+Spain scope with 5 articles
When Spain-only country filter applied
Then largus.fr does not appear in Target Sources list

results.notes: largus.fr (French automotive site) was rank 6 in France+Spain scope (5 articles). After applying Spain-only filter (46 sources total), largus.fr is completely absent from all 46 sources. Confirms: sources with no qualifying articles in the selected scope are removed from the list.

results.title: Filters apply before verdict tab scoping

steps.title: Given source type=Journalisme filter and AMELIORER LA VISIBILITE tab active simultaneously
When list renders with both filters active
Then only Journalism sources with VISIBILITE articles appear with Journalism-scoped counts

results.notes: Spain-only scope + Journalisme filter + AMELIORER LA VISIBILITE tab: 29 sources shown. All 10 visible cards type=Journalisme (0 non-Journalism). Tab scoping applied within already-filtered Journalisme scope. Sources: elpais.com(9), autobild.es(7), caranddriver.com(6), autonomiacocheselectricos.es(4), autopista.es(3) — all Spanish journalism with VISIBILITE verdicts.
